name: @marimo-team/export-client
description: Client for asking a running marimo session to produce export bundles.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --experimental-strip-types esbuild.config.ts
scripts.test: rm -rf .test-dist && pnpm build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.build.json && node --test .test-dist/test/*.test.js; status=$?; rm -rf .test-dist; exit $status
